summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in tailwind-kinetic 2.0.8
details: The package tailwind-kinetic version 2.0.8 was inspected across 8 files. No install-time lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content were observed, no credential or filesystem-secret reads (such as ~/.npmrc, ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, or browser profile stores) were present, no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints or obfuscated network destinations were identified, and no backdoor, silent-relay, or self-propagation mechanisms were found. The package's shipped content does not exhibit any of the enumerated supply-chain attack fingerprints.
